public_rationale: No lab had delivered AGI by the post date. Altman himself admitted GPT-5 misses his own definition of AGI (e1). Llama 4's launch was marred by a benchmark controversy (e2), and Meta delayed its flagship Behemoth model over quality concerns (e3). Grok 4 topped some benchmarks, but reviewers found it less useful in everyday work than its scores suggested (e4). Some users did praise it (e5), so Grok 4's reception was mixed. Read plainly as 'fell short of the hype', the claim holds overall.
limitations: 'Underwhelmed' is subjective, and Grok 4 had strong benchmark results.
Some Llama 4 evidence concerns Behemoth, which was unreleased, rather than the released Scout and Maverick models.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: No lab has yet delivered AGI, and models like Grok-4 and Llama-4 have also underwhelmed.

statement.excerpt: And of course, it is not just about Altman; others have been stalking the same whale; and nobody has yet delivered. Models like Grok-4 and Llama-4 have also underwhelmed.

from_speaker: others have been stalking the same whale
Grok-4 and Llama-4 have also underwhelmed
our_interpretation: The 'whale' is AGI, per the surrounding text about GPT-5 not being AGI.
'Nobody has yet delivered' means no lab had released a system widely accepted as AGI by 2025-08-14. The frontier labs' own leaders not claiming AGI counts as support.

'Underwhelmed' is read plainly: reception fell short of the developers' launch claims or hype, as documented in reputable contemporaneous coverage. It does not require the models to be bad in absolute terms.
The period runs from Llama 4's release (April 2025) to the post date.
criteria.support_condition: No lab had delivered accepted AGI by the post date, and contemporaneous coverage reports that Llama 4 and Grok 4 fell short of expectations or their makers' claims.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A lab credibly delivered AGI by the post date, or Llama 4 and Grok 4 were broadly received as meeting or beating their hype.

evidence.explanation: The leader of the most prominent AGI-focused lab said its newest model is not AGI, which supports 'nobody has yet delivered'.
